name: Nürburgring Nordschleife
notes: Chapters for learning the track one stretch at a time. Boundaries are the game's own section names, so they work on any layout that has them.

chapters.name: Hatzenbach
chapters.summary: The twisty opening: a rhythm of short left-rights. Smooth beats brave here.

chapters.name: Flugplatz to Aremberg
chapters.summary: Fast crests and the Flugplatz jump, Schwedenkreuz flat-out, then hard braking for Aremberg.

chapters.name: Fuchsröhre and Adenauer Forst
chapters.summary: The dive through the Fuchsröhre compression, then the tight Adenauer Forst chicane — brake early.

chapters.name: Metzgesfeld to 3-fach rechts
chapters.summary: Flowing fast lefts and rights through the forest, Kallenhard, Spiegelkurve and the triple right.

chapters.name: Wehrseifen to Bergwerk
chapters.summary: Down to the slowest part of the lap: Wehrseifen, Breidscheid, Ex-Mühle, then the critical Bergwerk exit.

chapters.name: Kesselchen and Klostertal
chapters.summary: The long uphill Kesselchen valley — exit speed from Bergwerk pays off all the way.

chapters.name: Karussell to Wippermann
chapters.summary: The banked Caracciola Karussell, then Hohe Acht and the Wippermann rights and lefts.

chapters.name: Brünnchen to Bellof S
chapters.summary: Brünnchen, Eiskurve and the Pflanzgarten jumps: commit, but land straight.

chapters.name: Schwalbenschwanz to the line
chapters.summary: Small Karussell, Galgenkopf — the exit sets up the whole Döttinger Höhe straight — and home.
